newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps cuts Mercury Finance debt.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps cuts Mercury Finance debt.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Friday it downgraded Mercury Finance Co's senior debt to Triple-C from Double-B-Plus and its commercial paper to D-Five from D-Four.

The downgrade on the commercial paper responds to Mercury's announcement that it will be unable to pay $17 million of commercial paper due today, Duff & Phelps said. It said the long-term rating cut reflects the lack of liquidity and the potential financial impact of lawsuits filed against Mercury.

Mercury Finance said Wednesday it had to restate its earnings lower for the past four years by a total of about $90 million because of accounting irregularities. Several lawsuits have been filed against the company.

Today Mercury said it cannot pay $17 million in commercial paper. The company said it continues in discussions with its lenders to satisfy its working capital needs but cannot predict the outcome of discussions.
